info.title: PiCache API
info.description: The REST API of PiCache (/api/v1). docs/API.md is the reference: it has every rule, message and field this description leaves out; the file is maintained by hand next to it (internal/api/openapi.json) and served at GET /api/v1/openapi.json. Extensions: x-picache-permission (P public, R any authenticated principal, U the own account in a browser session, A admin, S an admin's browser session, X the configuration export), x-picache-lock (the class of PICACHE_CONFIG_LOCKED: none, locked, exempt, pause), x-picache-destructive (refused while PICACHE_DESTRUCTIVE_API=false) and x-picache-extra (an endpoint outside the route registry).

Request: –

Response: 200 {deleted:int}: ends every lease (all rows, dynamic and on reserved addresses, in one transaction; pending offers and the quarantine too). While serving, devices keep their addresses until they renew; the neighbour check keeps protecting addresses still in use. Audited as dhcp.leases.reset (details {leases})

post.description:
Request: –

Response: dhcp.ProbeResult {servers:[{address, serverId, offer?, mac?}], durationMs}: sends a relay-style DHCPDISCOVER out of the configured interface (else the default-route interface) and collects the offers for 5 s; mac from the neighbour table. While DHCP is switched off, UDP port 67 is opened for this search only. The answers count as other servers for 10 minutes (blocker other-server), and the probe replaces the earlier probe answers of the interface. 400 field:"dhcp.interface" when the interface cannot be probed, 429 within 10 s of the previous probe through the API, 503 when DHCP is unavailable here or UDP port 67 cannot be opened (with the reason; in an installation that opens the DHCP ports only at start, i.e. Docker, the message says that the search needs DHCP switched on). Audited as dhcp.probe (details {servers})

Request: –

Response: 204: (1) the settings section dhcp back to its defaults through the normal settings update (announcements withdrawn, sockets closed, markers removed, names rebuilt; if that fails nothing else happens), (2) every reservation and lease deleted in one transaction, (3) the in-memory leases, offers, quarantine and names cleared. Other-server detections, the last probe, the exchange log and the other IPv6 announcers are kept (observations of the network). Audited as dhcp.reset (details {leases, statics}; no separate settings.update event); when the settings were reset but deleting the reservations and leases failed, the answer is the error and the reset is audited all the same (details {settings:true, leases:0, statics:0, error})
